items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 197:1
items.html: Behold, in general there are two pregnancies: the first pregnancy is made by the upper one, at the time when the lower one is still in the Klipa and has no reality whatsoever in holiness, and then it is corrected together with the AHP of the upper one, that is, at the time when the upper one raises and corrects his AHP, the GE of the lower one are drawn after them and are corrected with them, because they are always attached one to the other, as is known. And this was on the eve of Shabbat, in the first aspect, because the First Man was created, for then the worlds ascended by themselves, since each and every one was clarified by its upper one, and the lower one itself could not help itself, for it had no reality at all yet. Therefore they are then discerned as ascending by themselves, that is, not by their own [doing].
